hints.title: Subarray Bitwise OR Monotonicity
hints.text: For any fixed ending index, extending the subarray to the left can only set additional bits, so there are at most 30 distinct bitwise OR values.

hints.title: Set DP Transitions
hints.text: Maintain the set of reachable bitwise OR values ending at index i - 1, and compute new values by bitwise ORing with nums[i].

hints.title: Minimal Absolute Difference
hints.text: Update the answer with abs(val - k) for every reachable value. Return 0 immediately if an exact match is discovered.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: max A: maximum element in nums
complexity.notes: At most 30 distinct bitwise OR prefix values per index.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all n^2 subarrays causes TLE when n = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space as each set contains at most 30 integers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverage the logarithmic bound of monotonic bitwise OR sets.
